course.title: Footstool
course.classification: School-developed Stage 4 introductory elective aligned to Industrial Technology - Timber industry
course.project: Produce the approved introductory timber Footstool project

outcomes.statement: in Stage 4 teachers may adjust the Stage 5 outcomes as appropriate to the needs of students in Years 7 and 8
applies risk management and safe work practices in industrial technology contexts
communicates ideas and processes in industrial technology contexts
assesses the impact of industrial activities and practices on society and the environment
selects and applies design, project management and technical skills in project production
selects and justifies the use of materials, tools and equipment to undertake projects
evaluates the functional, aesthetic, economic and environmental qualities of products
analyses and applies a range of industrial processes in production contexts
demonstrates practical skills in the production of projects
investigates and explains a range of industry careers, enterprise opportunities and practices

teacher_to_confirm.item: Confirm how this 50-hour unit contributes to the school's elective structure and any 100-hour Industrial Technology course.
teacher_to_confirm.due_before: Before representing the unit as a full syllabus course

teacher_to_confirm.item: Confirm the current plan, permitted variations, induction, SOPs, tools, PPE, supervision and risk controls.
Confirm task authority, outcomes, marks, dates, conditions, adjustments and submission method.
Confirm the approved finish, SDS/product instructions, work area, drying and storage arrangements.
Map industry careers, enterprise opportunities and practices elsewhere if this unit contributes to a full 100-hour course; the current site does not teach INT5-IND-01.
